Outcome (b) as the dispatch words it is NOT available: 'a compiled statement of why no route through the currently landed machinery can succeed' is false. A landed route DOES succeed on the idle-pumpable sub-regime (compiled this dispatch), so recording the frontier as closed would have been a factual error. The plan's three pinned Lean Challenge signatures were verified at PLAN time, not deferred to implementation: the extracted challenge block (import LadderIdle + LadderCell, namespace FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.RaySummary, three sorry bodies) elaborated under lake env lean with exit 0 and exactly three 'declaration uses sorry' warnings and no errors. That simultaneously confirmed (a) the signatures lifted from evidence/route-a-idle-pump-discharge.lean are faithful against the live tree, and (b) the added import LadderCell edge into LadderIdle is acyclic. Phase 1 is therefore transcription-and-scoping work, not proof work.

Running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the draft plan at authoring time caught two generated surfaces the draft had missed. Its generated-surface appending stage adds every README whose BEGIN GENERATED inventory block covers a directory on an edited .lean file's ancestor chain; the draft Phase 4 named only README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md, while FormalSystem/README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/README.md also carry such blocks. Caught before dispatch instead of as a red check-module-invariants INV finding mid-implementation.

The 918 territory collision is unavoidable for this plan, not an artifact of its phase split, and could not be engineered around. Any change to Lean source line counts moves typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count, which .githooks/pre-commit enforces as BLOCKING on any commit whose staged set touches a .lean path, so the regeneration cannot be deferred to a reconciliation phase; status.typ is in 918's declared file_scope. The same applies to the four ancestor-chain inventory READMEs (Phase 4), Tests/BimodalTest/Metalogic/KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean (Phase 3) and scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh (Phase 2) -- every one of them 918's. Resolution recorded in plan Decision 6: declare every shared path so orchestrate-batch-admit.sh serializes the pair, rather than narrowing scope (which would drop two of the three deliverables) or adding a dependencies edge from inside the implement dispatch (which would block 924's own admission, including its non-colliding phases).

Phase 1 territory risk did not materialize: the plan's declared 918 collision on typst/generated/status.typ was moot because 918 and 925 are both status=completed with no uncommitted edits, so no phase closed [BLOCKED] on territory. The three evidence-file declarations transcribed verbatim and compiled first try; both scoped builds and the full library build are green.

The plan's task list specified three fully-qualified '#print axioms' lines at file end, matching the file's existing convention. forwardSlackWitnessed_of_cell_idleRunPumpable's fully-qualified form is 106 characters and tripped linter.style.longLine, which is a build failure under CI's --wfail. Resolved by wrapping the three new lines in a bare section with 'open FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.RaySummary' rather than repeating the namespace; the two pre-existing lines keep their fully-qualified form.
